## What happened

CHG-0114 records the change titled “SMS invitations go live”. The change starts on 2021-01-04. From that date, the service will use SMS messaging as part of the invitation process. This notice confirms the change for staff who manage or support invitation services.

## Cause

The change is required because of the New contact gateway contract. The contract provides the basis for sending invitation messages through the contact gateway and supports the move to SMS notifications.

## Effect

People with a phone get an SMS with each invitation. This provides an additional way for invitations to reach people and applies whenever an invitation is issued. Staff should take this effect into account when responding to service queries or supporting users who receive invitations.

Questions about this notice go to the service desk quoting CHG-0114.
